_about: One-line descriptions of the 77 Banking77 queues, written for the 9f-h label-string gate without reusing the original intent names. They are embedded as the zero-shot options in place of the names.
activate_my_card: Customer wants to start using a newly received card for the first time
age_limit: Question about how old someone must be to open or hold an account
apple_pay_or_google_pay: Adding the card to a phone wallet and paying from the phone
atm_support: Which cash machines can be used and problems using them
automatic_top_up: Setting up money to be added to the account on its own when the balance runs low
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Money sent from another bank has not appeared in the balance yet
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A paper deposit or cash paid in is not reflected in the balance
beneficiary_not_allowed: The system refuses to accept the person the customer wants to pay
cancel_transfer: Customer wants to stop a payment they already sent
card_about_to_expire: The card's end date is approaching and the customer asks what happens next
card_acceptance: Whether shops and services take this card
card_arrival: When the card that was ordered will show up in the post
card_delivery_estimate: How long shipping a card to the customer's address takes
card_linking: Connecting a card to the account or to another product
card_not_working: The card is declined or does nothing when the customer tries to use it
card_payment_fee_charged: An unexpected cost was added when paying with the card
card_payment_not_recognised: A purchase on the statement the customer does not remember making
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A purchase abroad was converted at a worse rate than expected
card_swallowed: A cash machine kept the card and did not give it back
cash_withdrawal_charge: A cost appeared for taking cash out
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Cash was taken out that the customer says they did not take
change_pin: Customer wants a different secret number for the card
compromised_card: The customer fears someone else has the card details
contactless_not_working: Tap to pay fails even though the card otherwise works
country_support: Which countries the service is available in
declined_cash_withdrawal: Taking cash from a machine was refused
declined_transfer: A payment to someone was refused by the system
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A recurring payment left the account that the customer does not recognise
disposable_card_limits: How many single-use cards can be created and how often
edit_personal_details: Changing the name, address or other profile information
exchange_charge: A cost was applied when converting between currencies
exchange_rate: What conversion rate applies between two currencies
exchange_via_app: How to convert money from one currency to another inside the app
extra_charge_on_statement: An additional amount on the statement the customer cannot explain
failed_transfer: A payment the customer sent did not go through
fiat_currency_support: Which national currencies the account can hold
get_disposable_virtual_card: Creating a single-use card number for one online purchase
get_physical_card: Ordering a plastic card to be sent by post
getting_spare_card: Getting an additional card for the same account
getting_virtual_card: Creating a card that exists only in the app
lost_or_stolen_card: The card has gone missing or was taken
lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the banking app on it has gone missing or was taken
order_physical_card: Requesting that a plastic card be made and shipped
passcode_forgotten: Customer cannot remember the code used to open the app
pending_card_payment: A shop payment still shows as waiting to complete
pending_cash_withdrawal: Cash taken out still shows as waiting to complete
pending_top_up: Money added to the account still shows as waiting to complete
pending_transfer: A payment sent to someone still shows as waiting to complete
pin_blocked: The card's secret number no longer works after too many wrong tries
receiving_money: How someone else can send money into this account
Refund_not_showing_up: A merchant promised money back and it has not arrived
request_refund: Customer wants money back for a purchase
reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed and the customer asks why
supported_cards_and_currencies: Which kinds of cards and which currencies work with the account
terminate_account: Customer wants to close the account for good
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Whether adding money from another bank costs anything
top_up_by_card_charge: A cost applied when adding money with a card
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Adding money using notes and coins or a paper cheque
top_up_failed: An attempt to add money to the account did not work
top_up_limits: The most that can be added to the account at once or over time
top_up_reverted: Money added to the account was sent back out again
topping_up_by_card: Adding money to the account from a debit or credit card
transaction_charged_twice: The same purchase appears two times and the customer was billed for both
transfer_fee_charged: A cost was applied for sending money to someone
transfer_into_account: Paying money into this account from elsewhere
transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The person the customer paid says the money never arrived
transfer_timing: How long a payment to someone takes to arrive
unable_to_verify_identity: The identity check in the app keeps failing
verify_my_identity: The app asks the customer to prove who they are
verify_source_of_funds: The customer is asked to show where their money came from
verify_top_up: The app asks the customer to confirm money they added
virtual_card_not_working: The app-only card is being refused
visa_or_mastercard: Which payment network the card runs on
why_verify_identity: The customer asks why they must prove who they are
wrong_amount_of_cash_received: A cash machine gave out less money than requested
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Cash taken out abroad was converted at a worse rate than expected
